test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following state has announced to enact legislation for the 'right to water' to ensure availability of minimum 55 litres water in a day per person?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has announced to enact legislation for the 'right to water' to ensure the availability of a minimum of 55 liters of water per person per day.
 
• This initiative is aimed at providing guaranteed access to water, recognizing it as a basic human right.
 
• The legislation will ensure that every individual in the state has access to sufficient and safe water for daily needs.
 
• The move is part of broader efforts to address water scarcity and improve water management in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Water scarcity** is a significant issue in many parts of India, affecting both rural and urban areas.
 
• Ensuring access to clean and adequate water is crucial for public health, economic development, and overall quality of life.
 
• Other states are also exploring similar measures to address water issues and ensure sustainable water management.
 
• The 'right to water' is increasingly being recognized globally as a fundamental human right, essential for the enjoyment of life and all human rights.
 
• Effective water legislation and management can help in achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 6, which aims to ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
